as_told.title: Visit to a New Mexico crash retrieval site with Tyler and Gary Nolan

plain: Diana Pasulka, a religious studies professor who wrote a book called American Cosmic, says that in 2016 she went to see a certain technology with people whose names she had to disguise in the book, including one she called Tyler. She says one of them, a scientist named Garry Nolan, has since come forward under his own name. She tells it as a first-hand look at the hidden world of people studying UFO material.
